svg.title: SwarmForm 3x3 Visual Taxonomy
svg.text: Same row = same leadership structure · Same column = same arrow direction
Peers write to shared file without reading
Peer copies A's file format or table
Peer A asks for missing data ↔ Peer B replies
Two leaders overwrite each other's drafts
Two leaders copy a specialist's result
Peer fixes a bug ↔ leaders merge it
Peers exit early; leader writes alone
Leader posts a template → all peers copy
Leader assigns tasks ↔ peers report back
